top_signal.title: Payment Processor for multi-currency international ecommerce
top_signal.summary: I am looking for an alternative payment processor that is reliable and does not create unnecessary disruption through lengthy or poorly managed account reviews.   I have absolutely nothing against KYC checks, compliance reviews, or requests for additional documentation. I understand that these are a necessary part of payment processing. However, I recently dealt with a European payment processor that handled both our online and retail transactions, and the way their review was conducted caused significant disruption to our business.   Our account was suddenly placed under review and payment acceptance was temporarily paused. We provided all of the requested documents relating to our company, retail store, and business operations. The main issue was that, instead of providing a complete list of requirements from the beginning, their compliance team kept requesting additional documents across multiple separate emails.   This unnecessarily extended the review process and left us unable to accept payments while waiting for their team to process documents.   Their customer support/compliance team ultimately took around two weeks to complete the review and reactivate our account. While the account was eventually restored, I still find that level of disruption unacceptable for a business that depends on payment processing every day.   The problem goes beyond simply losing transactions during the review. When payment processing is suspended, we also have to pause our Meta advertising
